description: Fields common to every stream-json v1 record. Per docs/stream-json-v1.md: every record has type, v and session_id. uuid is present on every record EXCEPT system/init, which has no uuid, so uuid is not required at envelope level; per-type schemas require it where the contract does. Unknown fields are allowed everywhere (v1 rule: ignore what you do not know).

subtype.description: Present on system records and on result records; not present on assistant/user/stream_event records in v1.

uuid.description: Fresh UUID v4 per record in real runs. Type is string only: no format is enforced because the shipped fixtures use the placeholder string "<uuid>", which is not a valid UUID.

v.description: stream-json schema version, currently 1. Must stay a const here so a v=2 record is rejected.

title: stream-json v1 envelope (DRAFT, APP-2 M1 preparation, not yet approved)
